g.text: Step 4 of 7: Map fields and rules
Optional. Add only rules your team already follows; yojo never adds any on its own. Names come
from your Jira. Press Next to skip.
A short name you can use in --set instead of the Jira field name.
"points" means the Jira field "Story Points" in every project.
In PROJ, moving an issue from To Do to In Progress requires Story Points to have a value.
